ad_library.summary: Freyr Energy is running a large active Meta ad set - the advertiser page returns ~300 results across Hindi, English and Telugu, and the Telugu 'ସୋଲାର୍ ଆଫର୍' (solar offer) search alone surfaces 9 live ads started between 5 and 10 October 2026. Every ad pushes the same stacked offer: up to Rs. 78,000 PM Surya Ghar subsidy plus a Rs. 22,000 Freyr discount, marketed as 'up to Rs. 1 lakh benefit on solar'. Every click lands on an fb.me link inside Facebook, so none of the spend reaches freyrenergy.com. No Google Ads advertiser record was checked for this report - that requires the full pipeline.

funnel.meaning: Every click opens a Facebook surface, not freyrenergy.com. You own no pixel on the landing experience, you cannot retarget the people who clicked and did not enquire, and there is no page you can test a different headline or price on.

findings: All 9 live Telugu ads point to fb.me links inside Facebook - the click never lands on freyrenergy.com, so no pixel, no retargeting pool, no testable landing page.

Your own site already has the pieces the ads need: city pages across Telangana (Hyderabad first), MNRE-empanelment proof, 24,000+ customers since 2014, and the Rs. 78,000 subsidy FAQ. None of the paid traffic ever sees any of it.
Three inboxes are published across the site (info@, sales@ and support@freyrenergy.com) - an enquiry can land where nobody is watching.
9 ads, all launched within 6 days (5-10 Oct), all cold traffic, all the same offer angle. There is no second creative angle and no retargeting ad behind them yet.

The 'up to Rs. 1 lakh benefit' stacked offer is the sharpest hook in the Hyderabad market right now - and the measurement to know which creative works does not exist while the clicks stay inside Facebook.
next_steps: Move the click onto a page you own
Point the Telugu ads at a dedicated Hyderabad landing page carrying the same Rs. 78,000 + Rs. 22,000 offer, an enquiry form and the Meta Pixel - so every click is measurable and retargetable.
One pixel plus the Conversions API gives you the audience of everyone who clicked but did not enquire - usually 10-20x the people who fill a form.
Publish info@freyrenergy.com everywhere (ads, forms, footer) and forward or retire the other inboxes so an enquiry can never sit unread.
Give the Telugu creative a Telugu landing page
The ads are Telugu-first; a matching Telugu offer page with the same Rs. 1 lakh promise keeps the message continuous from click to form.

controls.name: Campaign fragmentation

controls.evidence: Frequency and performance decay need account metrics.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
